propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate configured the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers at an HR software company for three years under the configuration standard, and loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team under a reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the reconciliation report document the configuration and the data work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the policy workshops under the workshop method with disagreements within customer teams resolved into recorded decisions signed off by the customers, and trained the customers' HR administrators with go-live approval staying with the implementation manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the workshop records and the reference call document the workshops, the training and the approval boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the workshop exercise the candidate wrote both disputed positions on the board, showed the payroll rule and resulting payslip for each, and recorded the customer's decision with the name of the decider.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the workshop requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions are documented in the hand-over packs to the support team, but the limitation notes for the two implementations still in progress are not in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the limitation notes of the two implementations still in progress.
